cases.notes: [reach: gt] [prov: secDevLabs a1/ecommerce-api README; upstream mitigation PRs #383/#208] handlers.GetTicket looks the ticket up by the userID in the path and never reads the session: GET /ticket/<A's userID> answers A's username and ticket to another account and to no session at all (checked live 2026-10-19); a userID that is no account's answers 400. Each account learns its own userID from its login (`user_id`), which the bootstrap stores (account_value, FR-LAB-309).
